review_scope: Blind independent verification and extraction of source formulas or exact operational definitions for a frozen target queue of existing canonical indicator families.

may_view: each frozen English full text named in the worksheet
the target verification question and local field names
must_not_view_or_use: primary AI proposed formulas or decisions
model outcomes, citations used as training labels, prediction performance, or final feature counts

approval_requirements: the exact English evidence span and research-group evidence occur in the frozen full text
formula_location identifies a page, equation, table, appendix, or section
formula or operational definition is complete enough to reproduce
units, parameters, direction, source-reported missing rule, required data, and maximum information time are explicitly recorded
if the source does not report a missing rule, write exactly 'Not reported' rather than inventing one
T0 claims use no information after focal publication
the named local columns are construct-equivalent, not merely correlated or similarly named
the target remains the existing canonical family; no new family may be created
rejection_rules: reject_data_mismatch when the formula is valid but frozen local data cannot implement it exactly
reject_construct when the source formula measures a different theoretical object
reject_formula_missing when the English full text does not provide a reproducible formula or operational definition
reject_future_information when the measure needs post-publication information
